title: 退換貨
description: 退貨與換貨的溝通用語

sentences.en: I'd like to return this item, please.
sentences.zh: 我想退這個商品。

sentences.en: Do you have the receipt?
sentences.zh: 您有收據嗎？

sentences.en: I bought this yesterday and it's already broken.
sentences.zh: 我昨天才買的，已經壞了。

sentences.en: Can I exchange this for a different size?
sentences.zh: 我可以換一個不同尺寸的嗎？

sentences.en: This product is defective.
sentences.zh: 這個產品有瑕疵。

sentences.en: I'd like a full refund, please.
sentences.zh: 我想要全額退款。

sentences.en: What is your return policy?
sentences.zh: 你們的退貨政策是什麼？

sentences.en: I'm within the 30-day return window.
sentences.zh: 我還在三十天退貨期限內。

sentences.en: The item doesn't match the description online.
sentences.zh: 這個商品跟網路上的描述不符。

sentences.en: Can I get store credit instead of a refund?
sentences.zh: 我可以拿商店禮券代替退款嗎？

sentences.en: I don't have the original packaging anymore.
sentences.zh: 我已經沒有原本的包裝了。

sentences.en: This was a gift. Can I still return it?
sentences.zh: 這是禮物，我還能退嗎？

sentences.en: The color is different from what I expected.
sentences.zh: 顏色跟我預期的不一樣。

sentences.en: How long will the refund take to process?
sentences.zh: 退款需要多久才能處理完成？

sentences.en: I'd like to exchange this for a different color.
sentences.zh: 我想換一個不同顏色的。

sentences.en: The zipper broke after wearing it once.
sentences.zh: 穿了一次拉鍊就壞了。

sentences.en: Can I return this without a receipt?
sentences.zh: 沒有收據可以退貨嗎？

sentences.en: I ordered the wrong size online.
sentences.zh: 我在網路上訂錯尺寸了。

sentences.en: Will the refund go back to my credit card?
sentences.zh: 退款會退回我的信用卡嗎？

sentences.en: I'd like to speak to a supervisor about this return.
sentences.zh: 關於這次退貨，我想跟主管談談。

sentences.en: The item stopped working after a week.
sentences.zh: 這個東西用了一週就壞了。

sentences.en: Is this item eligible for an exchange?
sentences.zh: 這個商品可以換貨嗎？

sentences.en: I have the tags still attached.
sentences.zh: 吊牌還在上面。

sentences.en: The product arrived damaged.
sentences.zh: 產品送到的時候就是損壞的。

sentences.en: I'd like to return this and buy a better model.
sentences.zh: 我想退掉這個，買一個更好的型號。

sentences.en: Do I need to bring any documentation for the return?
sentences.zh: 退貨需要帶什麼文件嗎？

sentences.en: Can you check if this item is still under warranty?
sentences.zh: 你可以查一下這個商品是否還在保固期內嗎？

sentences.en: I was charged twice for this item.
sentences.zh: 這個商品被收了兩次費用。

sentences.en: The shoes don't fit properly.
sentences.zh: 這雙鞋不合腳。

sentences.en: I'd like a replacement instead of a refund.
sentences.zh: 我想要換一個新的，而不是退款。
